recommended_first_data_slice.earth: SRTMGL1 V003 N19W156.SRTMGL1.hgt over the Mauna Kea candidate region; download the real protected ZIP through normal documented access and verify its label, hash, nodata, grid interpretation and vertical datum.
recommended_first_data_slice.moon: Already acquired PGDA LOLA Site04 surface, return-count and height-error TIFFs with README. Preserve supplemental status and MOON_ME/DE421 metadata; validate projection, vertical definition and interpolation/quality rules before producing terrain or features.
recommended_first_data_slice.rationale: This uses one already acquired lunar dataset and one precisely identified Earth DEM, avoiding an invented all-feature dataset. SRTM is connected to the listed Earthdata portal by CMR evidence.
recommended_first_data_slice.aoi_status: No new ROI or NASA-approved landing coordinates asserted by this report; derive a documented polygon only after metadata and common-scale support review.
remaining_blockers: SRTM scientific ZIP acquisition through authorized Earthdata access.
Coordinate/projection and vertical-reference review for both DEMs.
Documented comparable resolution, spatial support, masking and uncertainty rules.
Source-backed feature extraction and fixed normalization/calibration profile.
Derived artifact hashes and demonstrated frontend use.

rules: Portal and metadata access do not establish measurement availability, valid ROI statistics, or actual feature use.
Worldview renders are contextual visualizations; physical features must come from documented numerical products and quality flags.
Diviner lunar surface temperature and POWER two-metre air temperature are different observables; exclude unmatched temperature from cross-body scoring.
SRTM coverage does not provide McMurdo or the Iceland Highlands. Separate appropriate polar products need explicit provenance and licensing.
Relative humidity is not P/PET aridity; SoilGrids texture is not direct mineralogical composition.
Use a fixed common feature subset, real masks and comparable scale; do not backfill missing values or normalize on the current candidate list.
Unit-test arithmetic may use explicitly synthetic mathematical fixtures that never enter locations_dataset.json or scientific provenance.
